0022600104.text: The Hornets (1-1, 8th in the East, 3rd in the Southeast and 1 game back) host the Heat (0-2, 15th in the East, 5th in the Southeast and 2 games back) in Charlotte's third game of the 2026-27 season, with Charlotte on a one-game losing streak. Charlotte is without Coby White (calf strain), Grant Williams (hamstring), Kon Knueppel (hamstring) and Kylan Boswell (knee, surgery), while Miami's Pelle Larsson (finger sprain) is day-to-day and a game-time decision. The teams have not met yet this season, and the Hornets lost the 2025-26 season series 1-3 before beating Miami 136-106 in Charlotte on March 17, 2026.
